programme.desc: Huckleberry Finn, a rambunctious boy adventurer chafing under the bonds of civilization, escapes his humdrum world and his selfish, plotting father by sailing a raft down the Mississippi River.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV and worse than that, he's white.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Compromised by his affair with the first lady, a veteran secret service agent is framed as a potential presidential assassin and must rely on a hostile former prot‚g‚ to flush out the real culprit.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: Mads Mikkelsen stars as a pilot whose plane has crashed in a remote corner of the Arctic. Stranded in the wilderness he uses his ingenuity to survive. But he is forced to make a perilous choice between the safety of his camp and a trek into the unknown.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: For the Love of Benji
programme.desc: Benji is on holiday with his family in Greece, but after getting separated at the airport, he finds himself on another exciting adventure, now on the run from international spies!

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: Steven Seagal plays tough mercenary John Seeger in this high octane actioner. When Seeger is blackmailed into leading a highly dangerous rescue attempt to free a billionaire's kidnapped son in South Africa, he commits to the job. But when he discovers that he's been double-crossed the gloves come off - and now there's going to be hell to pay. Also starring Luke Goss and Michael Kenneth Williams.

programme.title: Bauhaus Spirit
programme.desc: Almost a hundred years ago, a radical artistic utopia was born in the city of Weimar Bauhaus. This is a fascinating look at how it still shapes our world today. Against the background of the 100th anniversary 'Bauhaus Spirit: 100 Years of Bauhaus' not only tells art history, but also contemporary history. Bauhaus made art, design and architecture political. The result was a spatial art form that wasn't above thinking about the distance between a bathtub and a toilet or the ideal chair. We go back to the beginning and celebrate the cultural history of modern spatial thinking that is as captivating as it is enlightening.

programme.title: Crash and Burn
programme.desc: The iconic true story of legendary Tommy Byrne- the worlds greatest racing car driver equivalent of George Best and Muhammad Ali rolled into one. The only thing standing in the way of fame and fortune was Tommys own hedonistic lifestyle sex, drugs and fast cars. Experience the remarkable life of the only racing driver Senna ever feared. His rise was meteoric and his fall spectacular

programme.title: Dragon Blade
programme.desc: Inspired by true historical events, this epic action thriller stars martial arts legend Jackie Chan, John Cusack and Adrian Brody. When corrupt Roman leader Tiberius arrives with a giant army to claim the Silk Road, Huo An (Chan), teams up his army with an mysterious elite Legion, led by General Lucius (Cusack), to protect his country. A tale of courage, friendship and honour.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: The Buddy Holly Story
programme.desc: Buddy Holly laid the foundations for a generation of popular music with his ground-breaking combination of country music and rhythm & blues.

programme.title: The Beaver
programme.desc: Two-time Academy Award winner Jodie Foster directs and co-stars with two-time Academy Award winner Mel Gibson in The Beaver - an emotional story about a man on a journey to re-discover his family and re-start his life.

programme.title: Ruth & Alex
programme.desc: When Ruth and Alex opt to put their apartment on the market over one crazy weekend, they discover that finding a new apartment is not about winding down...

programme.title: Mingle All the Way
programme.desc: (2018) Christmas romance with Jen Lilley. While testing her networking app, Molly finds an unlikely plus-one for the festive season. But will strictly business turn into something more?

programme.title: Christmas Cookies
programme.desc: (2016) Freshly baked romance with Jill Wagner. An executive is sent to shut down a small-town cookie business, but finds herself up against a handsome factory owner who is determined to keep going.

programme.title: Christmas In My Heart
programme.desc: (2021) Festive romance with Heather Hemmens. Back home for Christmas, violinist Beth starts tutoring the daughter of a reclusive country music star. Will they end up making sweet music together?

programme.title: Christmas Truce
programme.desc: (2015) Romantic war drama with Craig Olejnik and Ali Liebert. After falling in love amid the Battle of the Bulge, a US soldier and a Belgian woman vow to reunite at war's end - if they survive...

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: Love In Wolf Creek
programme.desc: On the verge of losing her wildlife refuge, Sam, along with the town's handsome newcomer, Austin, risk it all to save an injured white wolf.

programme.title: A Taste of Love
programme.desc: A struggling TV chef returns home to find that her family's restaurant is for sale, not able to compete with contemporary cuisine. Trying to save it, she reconnects with her childhood sweetheart and finds the inspiration she was seeking.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: Jenny Farrell has led an openly gay life - except with her conventional family. When she finally decides to start a family and marry the woman they thought was just her roommate, the small, safe world the Farrells inhabited changes forever.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: Dancing Through Christmas
programme.desc: OLIVIA is picked to run the Christmas recital of The Nutcracker. When a video of Michael practising ballet with Lily goes viral, Olivia sees how much dance really means to the community. Will Olivia be able to save her dance studio with Michael's help?

programme.title: Christmas For Three
programme.desc: When a successful bachelor suddenly finds himself as the guardian of a 10 year old boy, he leans on the smart and beautiful social worker for help, only to fall in love with the woman who turned his life upside down.

programme.title: The Christmas Cure
programme.desc: When Vanessa returns home for Christmas, her name comes up for a huge promotion back at work! She is torn between taking the job or staying home to take over the family clinic, while her visit has rekindled an old romance as well.

programme.title: An Evergreen Christmas
programme.desc: Evie Lee returns to her hometown for her father's funeral, facing family debt and tough choices between her music career and saving the family's tree farm.

programme.title: Made For You with Love
programme.desc: The owner of used wedding gown business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Passport to Love
programme.desc: Nicole, a successful travel blogger, meets Kade, a marketing rep for a travel publishing company, and they form the beginnings of a relationship while exploring an island destination. They juggle their work traveling around the world while seeing each other again. Both know there's something special between them, but it will be put to the test when Kade's competitive boss challenges Kade to thwart Nicole's business.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: A young finance executive inherits her uncle's mountain cabin only to discover that he also left half of it to the ruggedly handsome handyman that had been caring for it.

programme.title: Timeless Love
programme.desc: Megan seems to have the perfect life with a wonderful husband named Thomas and 2 adorable children. Then she finds herself awakening from a coma – and discovers she is not and has never been married. But when she meets Thomas for real, she seizes the chance to help him fall in love with her, again—for the first time.

programme.title: Minor Details
programme.desc: Someone at the prestigious Danforth Academy is trying to make the students sick! Who could be behind such a terrible trick? Is it Mia and Riley, the rich girls? Or could it be Emily, the Principal's daughter? Maybe it's the wacky Sean Niminsky, or even the eccentric Professor Plume. Whoever it is, Abby, Page, Claire, and Taylor will have to put aside their differences and band together to solve the mystery.

programme.title: A Lifeguard's Obsession
programme.desc: Awkward lifeguard saves a woman from drowning, earning a place in her life.

programme.title: Pool Boy Nightmare
programme.desc: Gale has a brief affair with pool cleaner Adam.

programme.title: Deadly Secrets by The Lake
programme.desc: Original idea by LMN & Harlequin uncovers Thornwood Heights' murder secrets.

programme.title: Obsessions Gone Too Far
programme.desc: Shortly after earning her degree at Northern Kentucky University.

programme.title: Amish Stud: The Eli Weaver Story
programme.desc: A man who called himself "Amish Stud" plots with his mistress to murder his wife.

programme.title: Kidnapped to the Island
programme.desc: When a teen aspiring to be a pop star disappears, her mom tracks her down, uncovering a sinister plot.

programme.title: Fbi: Negotiator
programme.desc: An FBI agent must negotiate with a woman holding a hospital hostage in order to get her hands on an experimental drug.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Stylist Rose inherits her grandmother's dress shop and reconnects with her old crush, Cole, sparking romance.

programme.title: Love & Where to Find It
programme.desc: Two local coffee shop owners despise each other but begin to fall in love while sending each other messages on their friends' behalf.

programme.title: Love You to Death
programme.desc: A prosecutor must work on a case which reminds her of her childhood, when her mother was killed by her alcoholic father.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a harried workaholic is given a universal remote that allows him to pause, rewind or skip past portions of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best of his life.

programme.title: Are We There Yet? (2005)
programme.desc: Ice Cube plays Nick, a playboy bachelor and sports memorabilia collector who dates a divorced mother of two young kids who never like the men their mom dates. Things go awry when Nick offers to drive the kids from Portland to Vancouver where their mother is stuck for work.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Indians are now a World Series contender. But last year's hunger is now replaced with complacency, and bad decisions by the new owner threaten to tear the team apart.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a harried workaholic is given a universal remote that allows him to pause, rewind or skip past portions of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best of his life.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards is a hapless young man consumed by unrequited love, and desperate to change his life, he makes a deal with the Devil who slyly promises to do just that - for a price.

programme.title: Lars and the real girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars strikes up an unconventional relationship with a doll he finds on the Internet. On the advice of a doctor, his family and neighbours go along with his delusion.

programme.title: India Sweets and Spices
programme.desc: When Alia returns home from university, she challenges her parents' elitist lifestyle expensive jewellery, lavish dinner parties, and gossiping aunties. But when she invites the son of a local shopkeeper to her mother's upcoming soiree, family secrets begin to surface.

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: David Ghantt is a simple man stuck in a monotonous life. Every day he drives an armored car, transporting millions with no escape in sight. The only bit of excitement is his crush Kelly Campbell, who lures him into the scheme of a lifetime.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: What could be worse for two cavalry officers than to battle with native tribes? To battle each other for the same woman.

programme.title: The Executioner of God
programme.desc: A former gunman turned priest seeks vengeance on three bandits who are masquerading as law-abiding citizens.

programme.title: Apache Rose
programme.desc: Old Western Movie from 1947 starring Roy Rogers directed by William Witney: Apache Rose - Roy is an oil prospector. His efforts to get drilling rights on an old Spanish land grant are countered by gamblers from an off-shore gambling boat determined to control the land (and oil) themselves.

programme.title: El Rojo
programme.desc: The Sorenson family is massacred, apparently by Indians. On the site of the killing, a town, Gold Hill grows up, run by a group of businessmen.

programme.title: Django the Bastard
programme.desc: A ghostlike stranger arrives to avenge a Civil War betrayal. Former Confederate officers who caused the massacre of their own unit begin to die one by one, as Django delivers chilling justice from beyond the grave.

programme.title: Laughter in Paradise
programme.desc: Henry's will is read to his relatives. Each of them will receive a fortune, if they perform certain acts.

programme.title: The Intelligence Men
programme.desc: Morecambe and Wise star in this tale of mystery and mayhem involving a spy racket.

programme.title: Don't Bother to Knock
programme.desc: A lively young travel agent's troubles begin when he mislays the key to his flat.

programme.title: Where There's a Will
programme.desc: Benjamin Stubbins is a penniless lawyer who has spent most of his money on drink.

programme.title: Ship That Died of Shame
programme.desc: Based on a short story by Nicholas Monsarrat and directed by Basil Dearden.

programme.title: Midnight Flight
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 AD: an artifact called Gunther's Scepter is sealed in a vault. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney and Nigel are hired to find it using a crystal and a stone tablet.

programme.title: The Executioners Mask
programme.desc: When a model's face is disfigured after she puts on the mask of a French executioner, Sydney and Nigel will try and find the tomb to reverse the curse.

programme.title: The Royal Ring

programme.title: Set in Stone

programme.title: Deadline

programme.title: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 BC: The Chinese invent an explosive gift egg. New York, 2001: A rival beats Sydney and Nigel to a map leading to the Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Vampires Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, a babe-magnet, professor and a novelist asks Sydney to help find Vlad Tepes' lost relic. And he isn't the only one after it.

programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney runs into her ex Gray and goes on a holiday with him to Bali, but when Derek Lloyd shows up to enlist her to find Parvati's Bowl, she can't resist.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Spencer Aimes is just your average, undercover, super-assassin accustomed to a life of flashy sports cars and even flashier women. But when he meets Jen Kornfeldt, a fun-loving computer tech, he finds true love… and happily trades international intrigue for domestic bliss.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: SURVIVOR is a gripping thriller about State Department employee Kate Abbott, newly posted in the American embassy in London. Kate is charged with stopping terrorists from getting into the U.S. which puts her directly in the line of fire.

programme.title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
programme.desc: Clary Fray thinks she is just an ordinary teenager living in Brooklyn, but everything changes one night when in a downtown club she encounters the mysterious and charismatic Jace , and witnesses a shocking murder.

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: In the fast-paced action thriller SNITCH, Dwayne Johnson stars as a father whose teenage son is wrongly accused of a drug distribution crime and is looking at a mandatory minimum prison sentence of 10 years.

programme.title: Blue Streak
programme.desc: Miles Logan (Martin Lawrence) is a talented jewel thief who has stolen $20 million dollars worth of diamonds and has hidden them at a construction site before being captured. Now, after three years in jail, he returns to pick up the diamonds only to find that the site is now a police precinct.

programme.title: The Man From Toronto
programme.desc: The world's deadliest assassin and New York's biggest screw-up are mistaken for each other.

programme.title: Gloria (1980)
programme.desc: Rowlands garnered an Oscar nomination for her fierce portrayal as an ex-mob mistress who takes care of a young boy after his family is wiped out by the Mafia. Gloria must rely on all her street-savvy to prevent both herself and the boy from being the mobster's next target.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Extinction
programme.desc: Milla Jovovich is back to kill more zombies in the third chapter of the hit Resident Evil franchise! Alice (Jovovich) joins the caravan and their fight against the evil Umbrella Corp.

programme.desc: Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) is a young FBI agent who is given a difficult assignment: spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) and her boyfriend (Antonio Banderas) who is suspected of leading a gang of art thieves.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Irresistible
programme.desc: When objects start to go missing from her home, Sophie Hartley (Susan Sarandon) suspects that a stalker is responsible. Then she meets Mara (Emily Blunt), the new co-worker of her husband, Craig (Sam Neill), and after seeing her in a dress that was among the vanished items, Sophie believes that Mara is obsessed with her. Unfortunately, she takes her suspicions too far, which leads to legal ramifications and her husband becoming concerned for her well-being -- but also to a startling discovery.

programme.title: I Smile Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Addicted to drugs and alcohol, a housewife's self-destructive behavior starts to take its toll on her husband and two young children.

programme.title: Rush of Fear

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London's Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett's captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I've Got Five Dollars”, “It Don't Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: James Brown
programme.sub-title: James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. The "Godfather of Soul", "Mr. Dynamite", and "Soul Brother No. 1" was a major force in 20th century popular music, influencing many musicians in numerous genres.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Le Quatuor Ebène
programme.sub-title: Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination. In their live appearances, tours and concerts, plus a succession of recordings built on the cornerstone of four albums made between 1960 and 1963, Loussier's group achieved the breakthrough to popular commercial success enjoyed by only a select few jazz musicians. In fifteen years, the trio sold over six million albums! On July 28th 2004, the day of Bach's 254th anniversary of death, the Jacques Loussier Trio perform a special concert at the famous St. Thomas Church of Leipzig - the city where Bach composed many of his most famous works.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg & Avery Amereau
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6 and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The composer wrote the symphony between 1877 and 1878, and dedicated it to Nadezhda von Meck – an exceptionally wealthy widow and great admirer of Tchaikovsky's music, whom the composer described as ‘my best friend'. Tchaikovsky explained in his letters that the symphony is characterization of the nature of fate. The work opens with a powerful motif in the horns and bassoons representing fate. The second movement expresses melancholy, whereas the third presents ‘fleeting images that pass through the imagination when one has begun to drink a little wine'. Although the ‘fate' motif reappears toward the end of the final movement, the movement has a festive character. This performance was recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Paul Simon
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.desc: Pierre Durand se dedica al salto de obstáculos. Su apuesta es un joven caballo en que nadie tiene gran fe.

programme.title: Catástrofe Inminente
programme.desc: Cuando un asteroide saca a la Tierra de su órbita, un hombre descubre el plan para salvar a la humanidad.

programme.title: Amo la Cocina
programme.desc: Tras una charla con Gordon Ramsay, un chef londinense convierte un pub rural en un restaurante gourmet.

programme.title: Jappeloup. De Padre a Hijo
programme.desc: Pierre Durand se dedica al salto de obstáculos. Su apuesta es un joven caballo en que nadie tiene gran fe.

programme.title: Protección: de Testigos
programme.desc: Una madre y su hija en el programa de protección de testigos son perseguidas por un sicario.

programme.title: Amor Atemporal
programme.desc: Megan despierta de un coma en el hospital. Su marido y los dos hijos con los que ha soñado no son reales. En una entrevista de trabajo, conoce a Thomas, a quien conoció soñanado mientras estaba en coma. ¿O quizás lo que vio era su futuro?

programme.title: Todo es relativo
programme.desc: Harry y Grace están enamorados, hasta que la madre de Grace pone patas arriba el mundo de Harry.

programme.title: La última batalla de los apaches
programme.desc: Un ranchero y algunos indios muertos acusan a los Apaches de haber roto el tratado de paz. Solo un chico sabe que los asesinatos fueron en realidad perpetrados por un grupo de hombres despiadados que pretenden empezar una guerra entre indios y colonos. Old Shatterhand trata de limpiar el nombre de su amigo Winnetou y se dispone a seguir la pista que le llevará justo detrás del fuerte de caballería.

programme.title: La flauta mágica (V.O.)
programme.desc: Adaptación televisiva de la famosa ópera de W. A. Mozart. El príncipe Tamino se ha enamorado de la princesa Pamina, pero ésta ha sido secuestrada por Sarastro. La madre de la princesa, la Reina de la Noche, lo incita a rescatarla, prometiéndole que si lo consigue podrá casarse con ella.

programme.title: Carmen de Bizet (V.O.)
programme.desc: Sevilla, 1820. Carmen es una hermosa gitana que trabaja en una fábrica de cigarros. La chica seduce a Don José.

programme.title: Tomboy
programme.desc: Tras instalarse con su familia en un barrio de las afueras de París, Laure, una niña de diez años, aprovecha su aspecto y su corte de pelo para hacerse pasar por un chico. En su papel de Mickaël, se verá inmersa en situaciones comprometidas por ejemplo, Lisa, una chica del grupo, se enamora de ella. ¿Cuáles serán las consecuencias cuando se descubra su engaño?

programme.title: Juerga de mamis
programme.desc: Un grupo de madres que apenas se conocen decide salir juntas a cenar para relajarse. Lo que empieza como una velada tranquila se transforma en una noche caótica que cambiará su relación para siempre.

programme.title: Los Padecientes
programme.desc: Un thriller psicológico que gira en torno a una joven mujer que se enfrenta a oscuros secretos familiares, mientras su salud mental y su percepción de la realidad comienzan a desmoronarse.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Francisco de Paula. Un grupo de adolescentes castigados en el instituto descubre la amistad y el amor mientras comparten sus problemas. En elenco podemos ver a Ivana Baquero, Patrick Criado, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón o Raúl Arévalo.

programme.title: Adiós a las armas
programme.desc: El conductor de una ambulancia estadounidense y una enfermera inglesa se enamoran en Italia durante la Primera Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Emergencias
programme.desc: Situaciones de emergencias al límite.

programme.title: Los amos de Brooklyn
programme.desc: Tres policías coincidirán en una redada en la zona más peligrosa y criminalizada de Brooklyn.

programme.title: Mentiras e ilusiones
programme.desc: Un novelista del género policiaco y de espionaje es perseguido por un espía basándose en sus novelas.

programme.title: Conspiración Militar
programme.desc: Conspiraciones gubernamentales: ¿Qué ocurre cuando un soldado accede a los secretos detrás de las guerras?

programme.title: Al borde del abismo
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre se tambalea en una repisa en el piso 21 para distraer la atención, está teniendo lugar el atraco de diamantes más importante del mundo. Prepárate para la emoción con Sam Worthington, Ed Harris y Elizabeth Banks.

programme.title: El caso Sloane
programme.desc: Maquiavélica película en clave de thriller político tenso y locuaz que recuerda a los mejores guiones de Aaron Sorkin ('El ala oeste de la casa blanca'). Una implacable y ambiciosa activista luchará contra un poderoso lobby en un intento de cambiar la legislación sobre el control y venta de armas.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: El astronauta Roy McBride (Brad Pitt) viaja hasta los confines del sistema solar para encontrar a su padre desaparecido. Descubriendo secretos que amenazan la supervivencia del planeta...

programme.title: Camino hacia la libertad
programme.desc: Un día, un olor familiar distrae al perro de su cometido. Es su dueño Joshua que ha llegado como un prisionero más. El Pastor Alemán no puede traicionar a su amo y le ayudará a huir. Juntos vivirán un duro y largo viaje hacia la libertad y la búsqueda de su hogar.

programme.title: Volver a vivir
programme.desc: June despiera en el hospital al que había ingresado debido a su demencia, pero cuando lo hace sólo recuerda la vida que tenía 5 años atrás. Sabiendo que su lucidez es temporal, no tiene tiempo que perder y escapa del hospital.

programme.title: Fuera de control
programme.desc: Will Graham es un hombre con oscuro pasado, que decide cambiar su vida, pero la desaparición de su hermano le obligará a volver para investigar la verdad de lo sucedido.

programme.title: Negación
programme.desc: Drama judicial basado en el libro 'History On Trial'. La película cuenta el juicio entre la autora del libro, Deborah E. Lipstadt, y David Irving, famoso periodista admirador de Hitler al que ella había acusado de negar el holocausto, motivo por el que él se querelló contra ella por difamaciones.

programme.title: Tiene Que Ser Amor
programme.desc: Durante las fiestas de Navidad, tres hermanas deciden viajar para para replantearse su vida amorosa.

programme.title: Todos los días
programme.desc: Este día no es muy diferente al resto de los días de Ned, sólo por algunos acontecimientos ocurridos.

programme.title: Una casa de locos
programme.desc: Un parisino de 27 años decide ir a Barcelona a estudiar el último año de la carrera de economía.

programme.title: Tres
programme.desc: Una diseñadora de sonido pasa horas trabajando. ¿Pero su cerebro está empezando a perder sincronización?

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Selena Gomez interpreta a una chica normal cuyo viaje de verano a París resulta ser la fantasía de su vida cuando se convierte en princesa accidentalmente al asumir la identidad de otra persona.

programme.title: Por amor a Grace
programme.desc: Un apuesto bombero no ha vuelto a ser el mismo desde que murió su mujer. Sumido en una gran tristeza y apatía, acaba de ser suspendido temporalmente de su empleo por desobediencia. Esa misma noche se desata un devastador incendio en el piso de una joven a la que le salva la vida.

programme.title: Devuélveme mi suerte
programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: Algo prestado
programme.desc: La vida de Rachel se complica cuando acaba celebrando su treinta cumpleaños acostándose con el prometido de su mejor amiga. Divertida comedia romántica protagonizada por Kate Hudson

programme.title: Space truckers. Transporte espacial
programme.desc: Año 2094. John Canyon es un viajero espacial que recorre la galaxia transportando mercancías. Su misión más arriesgada será transportar un extraño cargamento que puede suponer una grave amenaza para el planeta Tierra.

programme.title: Las confesiones del doctor Sachs
programme.desc: El doctor Sachs es el médico de una pequeña población. Por su consulta van pasando todo tipo de personajes, a los que Sachs esc…

programme.title: Pie de página (Footnote) (V.O.)
programme.desc: Un padre y su hijo unidos por una gran rivalidad. Ambos, profesores excéntricos que se dedican en cuerpo y alma a su trabajo. El progenitor parece un terco purista que desprecia el establishment mientras que Uriel, su hijo, se esfuerza en la búsqueda de reconocimiento y elogios.

programme.title: El cartero (y Pablo Neruda)
programme.desc: Exiliado de su país natal en 1952, el célebre poeta chileno Pablo Neruda logra que el gobierno italiano le conceda asilo en una remota y bella isla situada frente a las costas de Nápoles. Allí enseña a un cartero a usar la metáfora como herramienta de seducción y recibe de éste un oportuno aliento vital en su resignado exilio.

programme.title: Doc West
programme.desc: Cuando Minnesota West salva al joven Silver, el chico lo lleva a Holysand, una ciudad al borde del caos.

programme.title: Juntos Para Vencer
programme.desc: Un adolescente acosado fantasea con ser el compañero de Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Buster el robo del siglo
programme.desc: Basada en la vida de Buster Edwards, un encantador padre de familia que atracó un tren correo de Glasgow.

programme.title: Pixie
programme.desc: Joven planea robo y enfrenta criminales.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: Asuntos de familia (2009)
programme.desc: Vince Rizzo es un funcionario de prisiones que descubre en la lista de nuevos reclusos un nombre familiar. Se trata de Tony, un hijo que tuvo 20 años atrás y que abandonó al no poder hacerse cargo de él. A pesar de estar de estar casado y con una familia distinta, Vince se lleva a Tony a casa...

programme.title: Con la magia en los zapatos
programme.desc: Max Simkin (Adam Sandler) repara zapatos en una tienda neoyorquina perteneciente a su familia. Desencantado con su rutina diaria, Max tropieza con una reliquia familiar que le permite ser testigo de la vida de sus clientes a través de los zapatos que repara y ver el mundo de una forma nueva.

programme.title: Una noche con mi exsuegro
programme.desc: Durante una escala en Los Ángeles, el Señor Gallo, un testarudo y siempre ocupado hombre de negocios, decide ir a darle una sorpresa a su hija Ginnie. Pero una vez llega a su casa, descubre que ella se ha marchado sin dar explicaciones.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: En la pequeña ciudad turística de Nelson, Washington, el querido Jefe de bomberos C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) está acomplejado por su gran nariz. Una astrónoma, guapa e inteligente, Roxanne (Daryl Hannah), acude a la ciudad para estudiar un cometa y se siente inmediatamente atraída por otro recién llegado, el bombero profesional contratado por C.D. Chris (Rick Rossovich).

programme.title: Jack Y Su Gemela
programme.desc: Jack Sadelstein (Adam Sandler) es un exitoso publicista de Los Angeles casado con una hermosa mujer (Katie Holmes) y con hijos, que odia un determinado acontecimiento anual: la visita de su hermana gemela, Jill (también Adam Sandler). A Jack le vuelve loco lo absorbente que es Jill y su personalidad pasiva-agresiva, que ponen patas arriba su vida. Las cosas se escapan todavía más de su control cuando Jill decide alargar su visita. ¡Parece que no se marchará nunca!

programme.title: El Cielo Se Equivoco
programme.desc: Corinne Jeffries, una mujer dinámica y atractiva, nunca ha superado la muerte de su marido Louie en un desgraciado accidente. A pesar de los años transcurridos, su amor por él sigue intacto. Cuando quedó viuda estaba embarazada y dio luz a Miranda, convertida ya en una hermosa joven. Desde entonces, tuvo el apoyo incondicional de Philip, el mejor amigo de su marido, quien siempre ha estado enamorado de ella. Cuando Louie murió, en el cielo se le brindó la oportunidad de reencarnarse en Alex Finch, un apuesto joven. Al conocer a Miranda por casualidad, Alex/Louie entra de nuevo en la vida de Corinne, desbaratándola por completo.

programme.title: ¡Vaya vacaciones!
programme.desc: Para compensar el poco tiempo que pasa con su mujer e hijos, Bob Munro les promete un viaje a Hawai. Pero, en el último momento, cambia de idea y decide hacer una ruta por Colorado en caravana. Durante el trayecto, lleno de contratiempos, conocerán a los Gornicke, una familia con la que entablarán amistad.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 37, 38, 39
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Los indomables
programme.desc: Un detective de Pinkerton va de incógnito para infiltrarse en una banda de ladrones cuyo jefe es una aguerrida tabernera. Las complicaciones sobrevienen.

programme.title: Rifles apaches
programme.desc: En 1879, el capitán Jeff Stanton debe devolver a los apaches mescaleros a su reserva. Captura al hijo del jefe para negociar la paz, pero mineros codiciosos sabotean la tregua. Stanton es reemplazado por un coronel implacable, provocando el caos. Entre traiciones y conflictos, la lucha por la justicia y la paz toma un giro peligroso.

programme.title: El maquinista de La General
programme.desc: El maquinista de La General - Cuando los espías de la Unión roban la querida locomotora de un ingeniero, éste la persigue sin ayuda y directamente a través de las líneas enemigas.

programme.title: El cazador de forajidos
programme.desc: Una banda que trabaja para La Sombra está aterrorizando al pueblo. John Travers decide asumir el trabajo de sheriff y hacer algo al respecto.

programme.title: Propiedad Ajena
programme.desc: Miranda Sámano descubre un diario de 1848 y viaja a Texas en busca de sus raíces. Allí se enfrenta a los misterios escritos por su antepasada Amalia, mientras vive un romance que refleja una antigua historia de amor y la compleja relación entre México y EE. UU.

programme.title: La Hija
programme.desc: Los Amado deciden pasar un fin de semana en la casa de campo de la familia, pero el plan se ve alterado cuando Dominga, la mujer de la limpieza de los Amado, da a luz a un bebé en medio de una reunión familiar.

programme.title: A un Paso de Mí
programme.desc: Tatiana es una periodista con una vida rutinaria en todos sus aspectos y una reciente relación amorosa fallida. Motivada por su mejor amiga, decide hacer una parada y viajar por Costa Rica para encontrarse a sí misma y a la paz interior.

programme.title: Como te ves, me vi
programme.desc: La juventud rechaza los principios que les pretenden inculcar los adultos, quienes parecen haberse olvidado que practicaron los mismos excesos. A causa de esta incongruencia el comportamiento de los adolescentes es desmedido, frenético, a veces al punto de la tragedia.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se ve atrapada en un triángulo amoroso inusual. Se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir, pero 30 años después se encuentra perdida en su propia prisión...

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: La conspiración del silencio
programme.desc: El joven fiscal Johann Radmann encuentra unos documentos que le permiten poner en marcha un proceso judicial contra algunos miembros de las SS que sirvieron en Auschwitz. Pero los horrores del pasado y la hostilidad hacia su trabajo lo llevan cerca del colapso, pues le resulta casi imposible abrirse paso a través de un laberinto en el que todo el mundo parece estar implicado o ser culpable.

programme.title: Madame
programme.desc: Anne y Bob, una pareja americana que vive en París, organizan una cena e invitan a diez amigos. El hijo de Bob llega por sorpresa y el número total de invitados es ahora de 13. La supersticiosa Anne le pide a su criada, María, que pretenda ser un rico amigo español y se unan a la mesa. María conoce a David, un aristócrata británico. Ambos se gustan y continuarán su relación.

programme.title: La Mujer sin Piano
programme.desc: Un ama de casa casada para la que no hay nada comparable a la íntima satisfacción de ver el plato humeante servido con admirable puntualidad a la hora de la comida. Veinticuatro horas de su vida de la que una noche decide escapar, y cuenta todo lo que le pasa en esta fuga.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era
programme.desc: Este film narra tres historias de amor urbanas. Álex y Lucía se encuentran, empiezan a conocerse y entre ellos surge un romance. Paz y Jorge ven impotentes cómo su relación se apaga sin saber qué hacer. Finalmente, Albert e Irene vuelven a verse tras varios decenios de separación.

programme.title: El pomo azul
programme.desc: Soledad, que forma una pareja aparentemente consolidada con Juan, busca el piso más apropiado para su futuro en común.

programme.title: La final
programme.desc: Tres amigos hinchas del Atlético Madrid y tres chicas seguidoras del Real Madrid: todos protagonizan una historia de amor la semana de la final de Champions. Aure y Andrea tienen una tensión sexual no resuelta desde la adolescencia, fruto de la casualidad, surge el reencuentro.

programme.title: The Food of the Gods
programme.desc: A group of friends travel to a remote Canadian island to hunt, only to be attacked by giant killer animals which have populated the place.

programme.title: Cuadecuc Vampir
programme.desc: An analysis of the construction mechanism for the magic in dominant narrative cinema though the filming of Nachts, wenn Dracula erwacht (1970), a commercial film by Jesus Franco.

programme.title: Lobo Generacion AKA Generation Wolf (TV Cut)
programme.desc: Un joven emprendedor recurre a medidas desesperadas para salvar su negocio, pero ¿los suenos de este ambicioso Lobo lo sacaran del bosque o lo enjaularan para siempre?

programme.title: Blood Honey
programme.desc: Tortured by the memory of a childhood trauma, a woman returns after a decade to her family's fly-in hunting lodge to assist her siblings with their dying father, only to find herself stuck in a life threatening nightmare.

programme.title: Catástrofe en la Tierra
programme.desc: Después de un destello en el cielo, la Luna desaparece. Tras un segundo destello, nadie recuerda nada. Once meses después la Tierra se ha convertido en un lugar postapocalíptico, ya que fue absorbida por un agujero de gusano. Rodeados de catástrofes naturales constantes y sin forma alguna de civilización, los supervivientes deberán encontrar un lugar seguro donde volver a empezar.

programme.title: Santos y soldados
programme.desc: Cuatro soldados estadounidenses y un británico durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial luchan por regresar al territorio aliado después de ser separados de las fuerzas estadounidenses durante la histórica Masacre de Malmedy.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer 1
programme.desc: Un monje caucásico de Shanghai se infiltra en los bajos fondos para encontrar a los asesinos de su Gran Maestro espiritual femenino.

programme.title: Bermuda Tentacles
programme.desc: Cuando el Air Force One se hunde en el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía a su mejor equipo de rescate. Pero al rescatar al presidente, el equipo despierta a una criatura que amenaza a toda la costa este.

programme.title: Una amenaza en la sombra
programme.desc: Wes Rawlins es un cazarecompensas y hombre de pocas palabras. Queda devastado cuando su madre es asesinada por una pareja de forajidos.

programme.title: Infalible
programme.desc: Kevin, Rob y Sam son miembros de un grupo que, sólo en teoría, planea asaltos perfectos, como hobby, sin la menor intención de llevarlos a cabo. Un gángster encuentra parte de su material de trabajo y decide chantajearlos para que realicen un robo millonario.

programme.title: La Jungla
programme.desc: Jungle está basada en la historia real de Yossi Ghinsberg, un aventurero que sobrevivió para escribir un bestseller de memorias sobre su aventura en el interior del Amazonas. El viaje de Yossi y sus amigos acabó convirtiéndose en un calvario tan aterrador como psicológico.

programme.title: Perfect weapon (Arma Perfecta)
programme.desc: En un futuro no muy lejano, una organización gubernamental y secreta dirigida por EL DIRECTOR controla todos los aspectos de la vida. Todos “los enemigos del estado” son castigados de manera severa y muchos de ellos son ejecutados mediante asesinos de la organización.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: A un agente especial estadounidense caído en desgracia (John Cusack) se le encarga la rutinaria misión de proteger a una joven civil (Malin Akerman), cifradora de códigos de defensa, en una estación emisora secreta en Gran Bretaña.

programme.title: Winter War
programme.desc: En la II GM, el teniente Robert Cappa y su pelotón defienden una posición vital del último ataque nazi.

programme.title: Soldado de Fortuna
programme.desc: Un antiguo miembro de los Boinas Verdes debe llevar a cabo una misión cerca de la frontera de Afganistán.

programme.title: Terms & Conditions
programme.desc: El asesino a sueldo Vet Jones recibe un ultimátum de su antiguo jefe: mata al objetivo o muere su hijo.

programme.title: Breakout
programme.desc: Un cerebro criminal se enfrenta a un oficial retirado.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: Jack Justice es un policía que está suspendido de la fuerza policial debido a sus acciones imprudentes.

programme.title: Simbad Y El Ojo Del Tigre
programme.desc: Simbad (Patrick Wayne), osado marino y príncipe de Bagdad, zarpa rumbo a Charnak para obtener la aprobación del príncipe Kassim para desposar a su hermana, Farah (Jane Seymour). Pero Simbad descubre que Kassim ha sido hechizado por su malévola madrastra, Zenobia (Margaret Whiting). Para romper el encantamiento, Simbad debe emprender un viaje como ningún otro jamás realizado.

programme.title: The Spirit
programme.desc: Denny Colt (Gabriel Macht) es un detective enmascarado, un héroe sin superpoderes que protege del crimen a los habitantes de Central City. Colt persigue sin tregua al villano Octopus (Samuel L. Jackson), que asesina sin piedad a cualquiera que le vea la cara. Adaptación de la novela gráfica de Will Eisner.

programme.title: Soy Espia
programme.desc: La superestrella Eddie Murphy (The Nutty Professor) se une a Owen Wilson (Zoolander, Behind Enemy Lines) en un emocionante viaje cargado de acción. Famke Janssen (X-Men, GoldenEye) también aparece como una agente secreta supersexy. Un poderoso avión espía experimental es robado por un malvado traficante de armas y está a punto de ser vendido a un grupo terrorista internacional. El gobierno de los Estados Unidos prepara a un boxeador egocéntrico (Murphy) para que se una al sofisticado agente especial (Wilson) en una peligrosa misión secreta para recuperar el avión. Armado con los últimos artilugios tecnológicos y mucho carácter, esta extraña pareja podría ser capaz de salvar el mundo, si se pudiesen llevar bien.

programme.title: El Imaginario del Doctor Parnassus
programme.desc: El Doctor Parnassus posee el extraordinario don de guiar la imaginación de los demás, pero sobre él recae una oscura maldición secreta. Jugador empedernido, miles de años atrás hizo una apuesta con el demonio, Mr. Nick, con la que se ganó la inmortalidad. Siglos más tarde, al conocer a su amor verdadero, Dr. Parnassus hizo otro trato con el diablo, comerciando su inmortalidad por su juventud, con la condición de que cuando su hija alcanzara la edad de 16 años, pasará a ser propiedad de Mr. Nick.
